title: Quarter Interval Extent
description: Interval extents measured in quarter notes (crotchet beats) rather than seconds. The unit is carried by the extent_type tag and these descriptions: BOPP extent structs have no separate unit field, so a dedicated tagged type is the idiomatic way to indicate non-second coordinates.

start.description: Array of start positions in quarter notes, converted from quarterbeats_all_endings fractions.

duration.description: Array of interval durations in quarter notes (from duration_qb).
